strings.value:
Usage: %s [-s SKILL] [-W WIDTH] [-H HEIGHT] [-M MINES] [-h]

    -s SKILL    Select a preset dimension and mine count. One of:
                    Beginner:     9x9 with 10 mines. (default)
                    Intermediate: 16x16 with 40 mines.
                    Advanced:     30x16 with 99 mines.
    -W WIDTH    Set the width of the game board.
                Must be between 8 and 30
    -H HEIGHT   Set the height of the game board.
                Must be between 8 and 24
    -M MINES    Set the number
Invalid %s: %s. Must be an integer between %ld and %ld.
